title: The Lucky Side of the Bed

collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART IV (61-80, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it); near-duplicate in spirit of il041 Thirty-Seven Steps (the draft's own note: both are the routine went wrong; 80 is the easier one to drop); built for the owner to keep or drop

collection.description: A villager who always gets up on the left side of the sleeping mat rolls off on the right today.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) always gets up on the left side of the sleeping mat. Always. Today, still half asleep, (subject.he/she) rolls off on the right side. (subject.He/She) stands in the middle of the hut, staring at the mat, feeling that something important has gone wrong with the universe.

choices.label: Lie Back Down and Get Up Properly

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) lies back down, waits a moment, and rolls out on the left side. Much better. (friend), passing the doorway, sees the whole thing and decides it's none of (friend.his/her) business. The day goes perfectly well, and (subject) is quite certain that's no coincidence.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) goes about (subject.his/her) work braced for disaster. Nothing happens. The fishing is ordinary. Lunch is ordinary. By evening (subject) is almost disappointed. "Wrong side of the mat," (subject.he/she) tells (friend), "and nothing happened at all." "Maybe it's lucky too," says (friend). (subject) doesn't think so. (subject.He/She) uses the left side tomorrow, just to be safe.
